notes: Switching between Photos and Design keeps your place: each opens on the story you were last working on in the other
Photos selected across both pages of a spread can be aligned, distributed, spaced evenly, reordered and given a border as one group
The Gap between photos slider works on pages you edited by hand, as long as the photos are still in rows and columns
A photo placed on another story's page keeps its own story, and Create story on a draft always makes the whole draft
Fixes: exported pictures keep photos upright, a group resize across a spread no longer scrambles photos, Redesign spread works with an empty page, and small thumbnails can be dragged to a page again
